videos.title: What Are Brain-Computer Interfaces? Linking Mind and Machine
videos.filter_reason: This video provides an excellent foundational explanation, breaking down BCI operation into four clear steps (MIND), which directly addresses the student's struggle with core concepts.

videos.title: Multimodal interaction

videos.title: Context-Aware Computing: Research, History, and Examples | Albrecht Schmidt Interview - Part 1
videos.filter_reason: This interview with a pioneer in the field provides a deep, academic overview of the research, history, and fundamentals of context-aware computing, perfect for university-level understanding.

videos.title: UX for AR/VR (DevReach 2018)
videos.filter_reason: This conference talk is perfectly titled 'UX for AR/VR' and directly discusses the challenges and approaches for designing user interfaces in augmented reality, making it highly relevant.

videos.title: Wireality: Enabling Complex Tangible Geometries in Virtual Reality with Worn Multi-String Haptics
videos.filter_reason: This is a high-impact, popular demonstration of a novel tangible haptic system, clearly showing how hardware and software can create convincing physical feedback in a virtual environment.
